---
title: "VISA: Visa Applications and Grants"
description: "Information about people who have applied for visas to migrate to Australia."
---

Information about people who have applied for visas to migrate to Australia.

*Provides official statistics and reports for visa applications, grants and major visa programs.*

It is the finer of the two provider identifiers in the block: COE2_PRVDR_ABN_TX_HASH_TRUNC gives the legal entity, while this code gives the registered provider that issued the CoE. The three CoE blocks on a row are ranked by course level, not by date, so this is the applicant's second highest course rather than their second course in time. It exists only for applicants with two or more CoEs, so counting providers from it counts pathway enrolments rather than students.","dsrc":"Department of Education, PRISMS frequently asked questions","durl":"https://www.education.gov.au/esos-framework/frequently-asked-questions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For student visas, education provider code based on the CoE with second highest course level. The custodian notes that for a secondary applicant the value is taken from the primary applicant, so a partner or child carries the student's provider location rather than one of their own. Where it differs from COE1_PRVDR_REG_STATE_CD, the applicant's two highest enrolments sat with providers registered in different jurisdictions.","dsrc":"Department of Education, PRISMS frequently asked questions","durl":"https://www.education.gov.au/esos-framework/frequently-asked-questions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For student visas, education provider location based on the CoE with second highest course level. It appears on the 2000 to 2021 visa application extract and carries the ABN_HASH_TRUNC name that business-side datasets such as BUSOWN, JK and PIT_PS also use, which makes it the block's most likely bridge to a business record; the ABS does not publish whether those hashes agree, so treat such a join as unproven. The three CoE blocks on a row are ranked by course level, not by date, so this is the applicant's third highest course rather than their third course in time. A third block needs three or more CoEs on one application, so it is the sparsest of the three and empty on most student visa rows.","dsrc":"Australian Government, business.gov.au, Register for an Australian business number (ABN)","durl":"https://business.gov.au/registrations/register-for-an-australian-business-number-abn","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For student visas education provider abn based on the coe with third highest course leve. for primary applicants only - icse / iris","k":"Education provider ABN (hashed and truncated)","def":"An eleven-digit Australian Business Number put through a hash and then truncated, so the stored value is a fixed-width opaque string. The three CoE blocks on a row are ranked by course level, not by date, so this is the applicant's third highest course rather than their third course in time. The custodian's own wording for this column says course level where the column name says course code, which is a wording slip: the COE1 and COE2 entries for the same position both say course code.","dsrc":"Department of Education, PRISMS frequently asked questions","durl":"https://www.education.gov.au/esos-framework/frequently-asked-questions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For student visas, education course level based on the CoE with third highest course level. This is the field the ranking itself is built on, and it is the same idea the Department of Education uses to sort international enrolments: \"Enrolments are allocated to sectors based on their course level within the Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF).\". Its five sectors are higher education, vocational education and training, schools, English language intensive courses for overseas students and non-award, so a three-part package of English, then a diploma, then a degree puts the degree in COE1, the diploma in COE2 and the English course here.","dsrc":"Department of Education, Explanatory notes for data relating to international students studying in Australia","durl":"https://www.education.gov.au/international-education-data-and-research/explanatory-notes-data-relating-international-students-studying-australia","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For student visas, education course level based on the CoE with third highest course level. Three vintages of the same fact sit in this dataset under three names, this one plus COE3_ABN_HASH_TRUNC on the 2000 to 2021 extract and COE3_PRVDR_ABN_TX_HASH_TRUNC on the extracts that run to 2025. It is empty unless the application carried three or more CoEs, so a filled value marks an unusually layered study package.","dsrc":"Australian Government, business.gov.au, Register for an Australian business number (ABN)","durl":"https://business.gov.au/registrations/register-for-an-australian-business-number-abn","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"(note: variable has been hashed)","k":"Education provider ABN (hashed text)","def":"An eleven-digit Australian Business Number carried as a text field and hashed, so the stored value is an opaque string of fixed length. The column sits on the visa application extracts that run to 2025. \"An ABN is a unique 11-digit number that identifies your business to the government, other businesses and the public.\" (business.gov.au), and truncating the hash trades a small chance of collision for a shorter key. The custodian's note that the value is for primary applicants only and comes from ICSE or IRIS names the departmental systems the value was drawn from, which is why it is missing on rows for family members. It is the finer of the two provider identifiers in the block: COE3_PRVDR_ABN_TX_HASH_TRUNC gives the legal entity, while this code gives the registered provider that issued the CoE. The three CoE blocks on a row are ranked by course level, not by date, so this is the applicant's third highest course rather than their third course in time. The visa application file holds three enrolment slots ranked by course level, so COE1_* is the highest course level, COE2_* the second and this the third. ABS describes the Home Affairs feed this comes from as carrying \"data on educational studies for student visas\", which is exactly this block of columns. It is recorded for primary applicants only, so a dependant travelling on a student visa has nothing here.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, PLIDA data and legislation; ABS Australian Statistical Geography Standard, Australia and State/Territory","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida/plida-data-and-legislation","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For student visas, education provider location based on the CoE with third highest course level. IELTS reports on a nine-band scale with a label for each band: Band 9 is \"Expert\" and Band 0 is \"Did not attempt the test\". IELTS_OVRL on the same row carries the score the label came from, so the two are one result expressed twice. It is populated only for applicants who sat IELTS.","dsrc":"IELTS, IELTS scoring in detail","durl":"https://ielts.org/take-a-test/your-results/ielts-scoring-in-detail","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"English capability (IELTS) proficiency","k":"IELTS proficiency band label","def":"A word label drawn from the IELTS nine-band descriptor set, one label per band from Band 1 to Band 9 plus a state for a test not attempted. Applicants who took PTE Academic, TOEFL, Cambridge or OET, applicants exempt from the English requirement, and applicants on visas that never required a test are all blank, so restricting to non-blank rows selects a particular slice of the skilled and student programmes rather than the good English speakers.","where":["madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_1990_25","madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_2000_21","madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_2000_25"]},{"n":"IELTS_OVRL","d":"The applicant's overall IELTS band score, the single number formed from the four skill bands.","full":"The applicant's overall IELTS band score, the single number formed from the four skill bands. English requirements and points for skilled visas were set against this number, which makes it the field to use when reconstructing whether an applicant cleared a threshold. IELTS_ENGLISH_PROF is the word label for the same result.","dsrc":"IELTS, IELTS scoring in detail","durl":"https://ielts.org/take-a-test/your-results/ielts-scoring-in-detail","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"English capability (IELTS) score","k":"IELTS overall band score","def":"A number from 0 to 9 in half-band steps, formed by averaging the listening, reading, writing and speaking bands and rounding to a half or whole band. The four component bands are not carried separately in this table, so the composition of the score is lost.","p":"2000 to 2023","s":"sourced","src":"IELTS, IELTS scoring in detail","url":"https://ielts.org/take-a-test/your-results/ielts-scoring-in-detail","lim":"It is not comparable with a score from another English test, and it carries no test date, so a score attached to a 2015 application may come from a test sat years earlier and a person who applies twice can show two different numbers with no way to order them. A labour agreement is a negotiated arrangement between the Commonwealth and an employer, industry or region that permits sponsorship in occupations or on terms the ordinary programme does not allow, so the flag separates a concessional pathway from the mainstream one. ABS describes this collection as holding \"working arrangements for skilled migration visas\", and this is one of those working arrangements.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, PLIDA data and legislation","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida/plida-data-and-legislation","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"For skilled visas with nomination, identifies visas under a labour agreement.","k":"Labour agreement nomination indicator","def":"A two-state flag attached to the nomination, set where the nominated position sits under a labour agreement and otherwise not set. It describes the nomination, not the person nominated.","p":"2000 to 2023","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, PLIDA data and legislation","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida/plida-data-and-legislation","lim":"It does not name the agreement or the concession used, so a designated area migration agreement, a company-specific agreement and an industry agreement are indistinguishable. It also cannot tell you a visa followed, because a nominated position can lapse or be withdrawn with the flag still set.","where":["madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_1990_25","madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_2000_21","madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_2000_23","madipge-mig-d-visa-2000-current / madip_ge_mig_vis_app_2000_25"]},{"n":"LAST_ON_DAY","d":"Marks which of several visas granted to one person on one day is the last.","full":"Marks which of several visas granted to one person on one day is the last. More than one grant can be recorded against a person on a single date - a bridging visa and the substantive visa it bridges to, a primary grant and a correction, a visa granted and then replaced the same day - and counting all of them counts one migration event several times.
